english.title: Knowingly concerned in fraudulent evasion of a prohibition of a drug of a temporary class
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were knowingly concerned in

(A)_[the fraudulent evasion of]_
(B)_[an attempt to fraudulently evade]_
(C)_[a fraudulent evasion of or an attempt to fraudulently evade]_

a prohibition in force with respect to a drug of a temporary class, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRUG..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(2), (3) and (4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
knowingly concerned in
a fraudulent evasion / attempt to evade
of a prohibition in force
with respect to a drug of a temporary class

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Any goods in respect of which an offence under this section is committed shall be liable to forfeiture.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a penalty of three times the value of the goods or a fine not exceeding £20,000 whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.
